title: Asking the Way to the Pharmacy
situation: A visitor asks a passerby for simple directions to the nearest pharmacy.
somali_situation: Soo booqde ayaa qof jidka maraya weydiinaya tilmaamo fudud oo ku saabsan farmashiyaha ugu dhow.
key_phrases: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?
Go straight on this street.
It is near the corner.
Thank you for the directions.
You are welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli ahow, farmashiyuhu xaggee buu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.english: Go straight on this street.
dialogue.somali: Si toos ah u soco jidkan.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is it far?
dialogue.somali: Ma fog yahay?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.english: No, it is near the corner.
dialogue.somali: Maya, wuxuu u dhow yahay geeska.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which corner?
dialogue.somali: Geeskee?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.english: The corner by the blue sign.
dialogue.somali: Geeska calaamadda buluugga ah agteeda.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you for the directions.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay tilmaamaha.

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.english: You are welcome.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan.

title: Finding the Right Building
somali_title: Dhismaha saxda ah oo la helayo
situation: A visitor arrives on a campus and asks security which building has the admissions office.
somali_situation: Soo booqde ayaa yimaada xarun waxbarasho wuxuuna amniga weydiinayaa dhismaha uu ku yaal xafiiska oggolaanshaha.
key_phrases: Which building has the admissions office?
Use the main entrance.
The reception desk is inside.
Take the elevator to the second floor.
These buildings look similar.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which building has the admissions office?
dialogue.somali: Dhismahee ayuu ku yaal xafiiska oggolaanshuhu?

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: It is in the white building.
dialogue.somali: Wuxuu ku yaal dhismaha cad.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: These buildings look similar.
dialogue.somali: Dhismayaashani way isu eg yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: Use the main entrance.
dialogue.somali: Isticmaal albaabka weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is the reception desk inside?
dialogue.somali: Miiska soo-dhoweyntu gudaha ma ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: Yes, the reception desk is inside.
dialogue.somali: Haa, miiska soo-dhoweyntu gudaha ayuu ku yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which floor do I need?
dialogue.somali: Dabaqee ayaan u baahanahay?

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: Take the elevator to the second floor.
dialogue.somali: Qaado wiishka ilaa dabaqa labaad.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you. I see the entrance now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda waxaan arkayaa albaabka.

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: You are welcome.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan.

title: Finding a Room in a Clinic
somali_title: Qol xarun caafimaad ku yaal oo la raadinayo
situation: A patient asks how to find an examination room after checking in at reception.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa weydiinaya sida loo helo qolka baaritaanka ka dib marka uu iska diiwaangeliyo soo-dhoweynta.
key_phrases: Which room should I go to?
Wait in the waiting area first.
Walk down this corridor.
The exam room is behind the blue door.
The room number is twelve.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I have checked in. Which room should I go to?
dialogue.somali: Waan is diiwaangeliyay. Qolkee ayaan aadaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Wait in the waiting area first.
dialogue.somali: Marka hore sug aagga sugitaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Will someone call my name?
dialogue.somali: Qof magacayga ma yeeri doonaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes, the nurse will call you.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kalkaaliyaha ayaa ku yeeri doona.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Where are the exam rooms?
dialogue.somali: Qolalka baaritaanku xaggee bay ku yaallaan?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Walk down this corridor.
dialogue.somali: Hoos u raac marin-kan.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Is it the door on the left?
dialogue.somali: Ma albaabka bidixda ku yaal baa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The exam room is behind the blue door.
dialogue.somali: Qolka baaritaanku wuxuu ka dambeeyaa albaabka buluugga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: What is the room number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarka qolku waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The room number is twelve.
dialogue.somali: Lambarka qolku waa laba iyo toban.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will wait there.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Halkaas ayaan ku sugi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The nurse will come soon.
dialogue.somali: Kalkaaliyaha ayaa dhowaan iman doona.

title: Moving Furniture in a New Room
situation: A tenant and a mover decide where to put furniture so the room stays comfortable and clear.
somali_situation: Kirayste iyo qof raraya ayaa go'aaminaya meesha alaabta la dhigo si qolku u ahaado raaxo leh oo bannaan.
key_phrases: Can we put the sofa against this wall?
The table blocks the door there.
Leave enough space for a chair.
The bed should face the window.
This furniture fits better now.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Can we put the sofa against this wall?
dialogue.somali: Fadhiga ma dhigi karnaa derbigan agtiisa?

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: Yes, but the table blocks the door there.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin miisku halkaas ayuu albaabka xannibayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Then move the table near the kitchen.
dialogue.somali: Markaa miiska u rar jikada agteeda.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: That gives us more space.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay na siinaysaa meel badan.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Leave enough space for a chair.
dialogue.somali: Meel ku filan uga tag kursi.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: One chair can go beside the table.
dialogue.somali: Hal kursi wuxuu tegi karaa miiska agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Where should the bed go?
dialogue.somali: Sariirtu xaggee bay tagtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: The bed should face the window.
dialogue.somali: Sariirtu waa inay u jeeddaa daaqadda.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Will that make the room feel narrow?
dialogue.somali: Taasi qolku ma ka dhigi doontaa mid cidhiidhi ah?

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: No, the walkway stays clear.
dialogue.somali: Maya, marinku wuu bannaanaanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Please keep the small shelf by the bed.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan shelf-ka yar sariirta agteeda dhig.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: I can do that.
dialogue.somali: Waan samayn karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: The room already feels easier to use.
dialogue.somali: Qolku hadda durba wuu fududaaday in la isticmaalo.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: This furniture fits better now.
dialogue.somali: Alaabtan hadda si ka fiican bay u habboon tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Great. Please leave it like this.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Fadlan sidaan uga tag.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: All set.
dialogue.somali: Waa diyaar.

title: Finding a Bag's Position
somali_title: Meesha boorso taallo oo la helayo
situation: A student asks where a bag is and understands simple position words.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa weydiinaya meesha boorso taallo wuxuuna fahmayaa erayo fudud oo meesha tilmaama.
key_phrases: Where is my bag?
It is under the table.
Is it next to the chair?
No, it is on the floor.
Now I know the position.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Where is my bag?
dialogue.somali: Boorsadaydu xaggee bay taallaa?

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.english: It is under the table.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ku hoos jirtaa miiska.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Is it next to the chair?
dialogue.somali: Ma waxay ku xigtaa kursiga?

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.english: No, it is on the floor.
dialogue.somali: Maya, waxay saaran tahay dhulka.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I see it now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waan arkay.

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.english: Your notebook is on the table.
dialogue.somali: Buuggaagu miiska ayuu saaran yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Now I know the position.
dialogue.somali: Hadda waan garanayaa meesha ay taallo.

dialogue.speaker: Classmate
dialogue.english: Good. Class is starting.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Fasalku wuu bilaabanayaa.

title: Turning Left and Right
situation: A passenger follows simple left and right directions from a taxi driver.
somali_situation: Rakaab ayaa raacaya tilmaamo fudud oo bidix iyo midig ah oo ka imanaya darawal taksi.
key_phrases: Please turn left at the traffic light.
Then go straight to the crossroad.
Is the hotel on the right?
No, it is on the left.
I mix up left and right.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Please turn left at the traffic light.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan bidix u leexo nalka taraafikada agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi Driver
dialogue.english: All right, I will turn left there.
dialogue.somali: Hagaag, halkaas ayaan bidix uga leexanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Then go straight to the crossroad.
dialogue.somali: Kadib si toos ah u soco ilaa isgoyska.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi Driver
dialogue.english: Do I turn right at the crossroad?
dialogue.somali: Isgoyska ma midig baan uga leexdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: Yes, turn right there.
dialogue.somali: Haa, halkaas midig uga leexo.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi Driver
dialogue.english: Is the hotel on the right?
dialogue.somali: Hoteelku ma midigta ayuu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: No, it is on the left.
dialogue.somali: Maya, bidixda ayuu ku yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi Driver
dialogue.english: Thanks. I mix up left and right.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Bidix iyo midig waan isku khaldaa.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger
dialogue.english: No problem. We are close now.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Hadda waan dhow nahay.

dialogue.speaker: Taxi Driver
dialogue.english: I see the hotel sign.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan arkayaa calaamadda hoteelka.

title: Reading a Map at the Station
situation: A traveler uses a station map to find the correct platform and exit.
somali_situation: Socdaale ayaa adeegsanaya khariidadda saldhigga si uu u helo barxadda saxda ah iyo meesha laga baxo.
key_phrases: Can you help me read this map?
The blue symbol shows the exit.
Your route goes through platform three.
Follow the signs inside the station.
These maps are easier than I expected.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Can you help me read this map?
dialogue.somali: Khariidaddan ma iga caawin kartaa inaan akhriyo?

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: Yes. Which station do you need?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Saldhiggee ayaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: I need Central Station.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay Saldhigga Dhexe.

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: Your route goes through platform three.
dialogue.somali: Jidkaagu wuxuu maraa barxadda saddexaad.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Where is the exit after that?
dialogue.somali: Intaas ka dib meesha laga baxo xaggee bay ku taal?

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: The blue symbol shows the exit.
dialogue.somali: Astaanta buluugga ah ayaa muujinaysa meesha laga baxo.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Should I cross the bridge?
dialogue.somali: Ma inaan buundada gudbaa?

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: Yes, then follow the signs inside the station.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kadib raac calaamadaha gudaha saldhigga.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: These maps are easier than I expected.
dialogue.somali: Khariidadahani way ka fudud yihiin intii aan filayay.

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: They are clear once you know the symbols.
dialogue.somali: Way cad yihiin markaad astaamaha barato.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Thank you. I can find platform three now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda waan heli karaa barxadda saddexaad.

dialogue.speaker: Station Worker
dialogue.english: You are going the right way.
dialogue.somali: Jidka saxda ah ayaad ku socotaa.

title: Finding a Lost Wallet
somali_title: Boorsada lacagta oo luntay oo la raadinayo
situation: A customer reports a lost wallet at a cafe and retraces where it was last seen.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa kafeega ka sheegaya boorso lacag oo luntay wuxuuna dib u raacayaa meeshii ugu dambeysay ee lagu arkay.
key_phrases: I think I lost my wallet.
Where did you last have it?
I paid at the counter.
Maybe it fell beside my seat.
Someone found it near the window.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Excuse me, I think I lost my wallet.
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli ahow, waxaan u malaynayaa in boorsadaydii lacagtu luntay.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: I am sorry. Where did you last have it?
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay. Xaggee ayaad ugu dambaysay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I paid at the counter.
dialogue.somali: Miiska lacag-bixinta ayaan ku bixiyay.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Did you keep the receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiidka ma haysataa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, the receipt is in my coat pocket.
dialogue.somali: Haa, rasiidku wuxuu ku jiraa jeebka jaakaddayda.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Which seat were you using?
dialogue.somali: Kursigee ayaad isticmaalaysay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The seat by the window.
dialogue.somali: Kursiga daaqadda agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Maybe it fell beside my seat.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa laga yaabaa inay kursigayga agtiisa ku dhacday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can we check there first?
dialogue.somali: Halkaas marka hore ma hubin karnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Yes, I will look under the table.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan ka eegi doonaa miiska hoostiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is not there.
dialogue.somali: Halkaas kuma jirto.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Let me ask about lost items at the front.
dialogue.somali: Aan hore ka weydiiyo waxyaabaha lumay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. It has my bank card inside.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Kaarka bangigayga ayaa ku jira.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Someone found it near the window.
dialogue.somali: Qof ayaa ka helay daaqadda agteeda.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That is a relief.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa nasasho.

dialogue.speaker: Cafe Worker
dialogue.english: Please check that everything is still inside.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan hubi in wax walba weli ku jiraan.

title: Finding a Nearby Cafe
situation: A visitor asks for a nearby cafe and learns where it is in relation to the bus stop.
somali_situation: Soo booqde ayaa weydiinaya kafee dhow wuxuuna ogaanayaa meesha uu kaga yaal joogsiga baska.
key_phrases: Is there a nearby cafe?
It is next to the bus stop.
Is it across from the bank?
Yes, it is across from the bank.
There are many places nearby.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is there a nearby cafe?
dialogue.somali: Kafee dhow ma jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is next to the bus stop.
dialogue.somali: Haa, wuxuu ku xigaa joogsiga baska.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is it across from the bank?
dialogue.somali: Ma bangiga ka soo horjeedaa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is across from the bank.
dialogue.somali: Haa, bangiga ayuu ka soo horjeedaa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Can I walk there?
dialogue.somali: Ma u socon karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: Yes, it is very close.
dialogue.somali: Haa, aad buu u dhow yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Are there other places nearby?
dialogue.somali: Meelo kale oo dhow ma jiraan?

dialogue.speaker: Local Person
dialogue.english: There are many places nearby.
dialogue.somali: Meelo badan ayaa dhow.
